title: dual tor: Show Mux Cable Status Produces Empty Table After Swss Restart
author: tahmed-dev
body:
#### Description
`show muxcable status` cli produces empty table after swss is restarted.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. restart swss container
2.
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
```
admin@STR43-0101-0101-01LT0:~$ show muxcable status 
PORT    STATUS    HEALTH
------  --------  --------
```

#### Describe the results you expected:
```
admin@STR43-0101-0101-01LT0:~$ show muxcable status 
PORT         STATUS    HEALTH
-----------  --------  ---------
Ethernet0    standby   unhealthy
Ethernet4    standby   unhealthy
Ethernet8    active    unhealthy
Ethernet12   standby   unhealthy
```

#### Output of `show version`:
`beta.14`

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):
restart pmon container fixes the issue

**- Why I did it**
Port configuration changes can leave keys for unused interfaces behind in STATE DB

**- How I did it**
* Add *MUX_CABLE_TABLE* to set of tables to clear on SWSS start, which
will clear HW_MUX_CABLE_TABLE and MUX_CABLE_TABLE
* Order swss to start before pmon to ensure that DBs are cleared before
xcvrd (running inside pmon) starts and re-populates the tables

comments.author: jleveque
comments.body:
> @jleveque , now pmon is affected by swss.

Thanks for the heads-up! Do we have any concerns that SwSS startup issues could prevent PMon from starting, thus causing thermal overload issues? I believe since this is only a `Before=` dependency, PMon should still start up even if SwSS fails. Can we confirm this?

comments.author: theasianpianist
comments.body: @jleveque This dependency should not prevent PMON from starting if SWSS fails, since `Before=` does not enforce any dependencies on the health of the SWSS service, it only waits until SWSS has either completely started or failed: https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/systemd.unit.html#Before=
